posts.caption: Netflix has officially canceled 'Ransom Canyon' after two seasons. Following a steep 43% viewership drop in Season 2, the Josh Duhamel and Minka Kelly drama won't be returning for Season 3.
posts.rewritten_caption:
📺 SERIES UPDATE: RANSOM CANYON CONCLUDES AT NETFLIX

Netflix has officially confirmed that romantic contemporary western drama 'Ransom Canyon' will conclude with its upcoming second season. Production executives noted that the upcoming episodes will serve as the final chapter for the Texas Hill Country drama.

The series, based on the novels by Jodi Thomas, followed interconnected family lineages and ranching rivalries on the Double K Ranch. Showrunners confirmed that Season 2 was developed to provide narrative resolution for core characters.

The final season will stream globally on Netflix, bringing the ranching saga to its planned emotional conclusion.
